context: Sho and Hina take turns at a simple computer game.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、このゲーム、一緒に、する？
lines.en: Hina, want to play this game together?
lines.style: Soft, hopeful opening. Small voice carrying genuine warmth. Gentle pace, no pressure—just inviting. The certainty of a child who trusts acceptance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, let's! I'll wait for my turn.
lines.style: Bright immediate yes. Enthusiastic but not loud. Patient warmth underneath—she's genuinely happy to watch him first. Slight upswing on the affirmation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Okay, I'm going to try my best.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Slight gathering of focus. Small voice, but steady. The concentration of a six-year-old taking something seriously because it matters to someone he likes.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: That was amazing! My turn now.
lines.style: Genuine delight without restraint. Bright energy on the praise. Quick anticipation building toward her own moment. Real admiration, not performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Playing together like this—it's really fun.
lines.style: Soft closing observation. Wonder at the simplicity of it. Small voice, thoughtful but not solemn. Warmth settling in—the contentment of being exactly where he wants to be.
